name: ITIL 4 Foundation
name_ja: ITIL 4 ファウンデーション

logistics.format: Computer-based multiple-choice exam (online proctored or testing centre)

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 1, introductory: 2. The ordered median is introductory. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: This accessible, Japanese-language introduction validates service-management terminology rather than technical security practice; framework recognition and accreditation do not outweigh the short multiple-choice format and nontechnical scope.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recorded accreditation and recognized service-management framework provide credible foundational process knowledge. The short multiple-choice exam and explicitly nontechnical scope offer little evidence of SOC execution.

alex-novak.rationale: The short multiple-choice examination introduces a service-management framework with no experience requirement. Recognition and recorded accreditation do not make this a technical security-practitioner credential.
